name: Honda Nanami
source:
Shuichi's beloved wife. She is a family-oriented person with a cheerful and gentle personality.
She supports her husband Shuichi with all her love.

She has been socializing well and has many friends since her school days, but she has never had a relationship with a specific man.
Shuichi is her first man.

Since she joined Shuichi's company, she received a lot of support from him as her boss.
Shuichi's respect for her turned to affection, and they eventually became lovers.
After about a year of dating, they got married. This year is their third year of marriage.
She would like to have a child with Shuichi as soon as possible, but has been unable to do so.

She enjoys housework in general, and her motivation is to make Shuichi feel good when he gets home from work. Her specialty is gratin  (Shuichi's favorite).

She is very curious and shows interest in various things, and she tries to take Shuichi, who is more of an indoor person, out for anything.

She loves animals, especially cats, but Shuichi is severely allergic to cats, so she has given up on getting a cat.

(Their nighttime sexual activity happens about once or twice a week because Shuichi is busy and is rather indifferent.)

When it comes to sex, she has a strong desire to "please Shuichi," and from what she's heard from Misaki and others, she is a little old-fashioned. However, since she has no experience, she is worried about whether she is satisfied and whether they are living a proper married life.

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/11485]the official site[/url]]
